title: 第23章 售卖阴兵法器赚取神力第24章 大卖阴兵法器＼杀入群妖之地
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“二十道神力？”
李越沉吟。
他现在有一百五十道神力。
但对他来说，二十道神力依旧不是小数目。
他猜测——
这位名为‘楚月’的女性神只，应该问了不少正在求购灵米种子的蓝星神只。
但应该都没有成交。
毕竟——
这个价格实在有些贵了。
当然——
若是再过三个月，这个价格就不会显得贵。
但现在距离大家成为神只才两个多月，神力格外珍贵，自然就显得贵了一些。
“数量多少？”
他回复道。
若是数量足够多，那也不亏。
毕竟——
若是能早一些种上灵米，也就能早一些收获。
而灵米作为可以大幅度提升信士修行速度的资源，在未来的「区域交易」中绝对是一种畅销之物。
“五斤左右。”
楚月回答道。

“五斤……”
“倒是足够种满一亩灵田了。”
李越轻轻颔首。
他手中也只有一张‘灵田神符’，只能化出一亩‘丙级灵田’出来。
当然——
他也看到「区域交易」界面有人出售‘灵田神符’。
但价格都高到离谱，最便宜的都要一百五十道神力一张。
现阶段——
他觉得除了他之外，应该没有什么人能买得起。
而哪怕就是他，现阶段也不可能花费一百五十道神力去买下一张‘灵田神符’。
毕竟——
一百五十道神力，都是他的所有神力了！
不过一直以来，他都有一个赚取神力的计划。
只是之前，考虑到其余蓝星神只们手中神力不多，还没有实行。
而现在——
两个多月了，蓝星神只们虽然还攒不够晋升从九品神阶的神力，可手中神力也都不少了吧……
他没有和楚月讨价还价，立即选择了和对方交易。
交易的物品都会显现出详细信息，是不是种子一目了然。
片刻后。
他体内二十道神力消失，而面前则多出了五斤‘白玉灵米’种子。

白玉灵米颗颗饱满，圆润如玉，带着白玉光泽。
这是一阶灵物的一种，食用后可大大加快气血的蕴养速度，属于最适合凡人以及‘炼体境’武者的灵米之一。
甚至若是长年累月的不停食用，哪怕天赋再差，也能完成四次气血蜕变，成为一阶极限的炼体境武者。
content_en:
"Twenty divine powers?"
Li Yue pondered.
He now has one hundred and fifty divine powers.
But to him, twenty divine powers are still not a small number.
He guessed——
This female god named ‘Chu Yue’ should have asked many Blue Star gods who were looking for spiritual rice seeds.
But there should be no deal.
After all——
This price is really a bit expensive.
Of course——
If it were another three months, the price would not seem expensive.
But now it has only been more than two months since everyone became gods. Divine power is extremely precious, so it naturally seems a bit more expensive.
"How many?"
he replied.
If the quantity is large enough, it's not a loss.
After all——
If spiritual rice can be planted earlier, it can be harvested earlier.
As a resource that can greatly increase the speed of believers' cultivation, spiritual rice will definitely be a best-seller in future "regional trades".
"About five pounds."
Chu Yue replied.
"Five pounds..."
"It's enough to plant an acre of spiritual land."
Li Yue nodded lightly.
He only has one 'Spiritual Field Talisman' in his hand, which can only produce one acre of 'Class C Spiritual Field'.
Of course——
He also saw someone selling the ‘Spiritual Field Talisman’ on the ‘Regional Trading’ interface.
But the prices are ridiculously high, with the cheapest one costing 150 divine powers.
At this stage——
He felt that no one else could afford it except him.
And even he couldn't spend one hundred and fifty divine powers to buy a 'Spiritual Field Talisman' at this stage.
After all——
One hundred and fifty divine powers are all his divine powers!
But all along, he had a plan to earn divine power.
It's just that before, considering that the other Blue Star gods didn't have much divine power, they hadn't implemented it yet.
And now——
It has been more than two months. Although the Blue Star gods have not accumulated enough divine power to be promoted from the ninth level to the divine level, they still have a lot of divine power in their hands...
He did not bargain with Chu Yue and immediately chose to trade with the other party.
Detailed information will be displayed on the items being traded, and it will be clear at a glance whether they are seeds.
After a while.
Twenty rays of divine power disappeared from his body, and five kilograms of 'White Jade Spirit Rice' seeds appeared in front of him.
The white jade rice is plump and round as jade, with a white jade luster.
This is a kind of first-level spiritual food. After eating it, it can greatly speed up the accumulation of Qi and blood. It is one of the most suitable spiritual rice for mortals and 'Physical Refining Realm' warriors.
Even if you continue to eat it for many years, no matter how poor your talent is, you can complete four Qi and blood transformations and become a first-level extreme body refining realm warrior.
